title: NBI probes foreigners’ fraudulent acquisition of Filipino citizenship papers

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) is conducting a nationwide investigation into cases involving foreigners who fraudulently obtained birth certificates, passports and other documents to falsely establish Filipino citizenship, Director Melvin Matibag said Thursday. The probe follows Matibag’s earlier concerns about illegal activities involving foreign nationals, including Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (Pogos) and scam hubs in the country. In Memorandum Order No. 22 dated Oct. 20, Matibag instructed all regional directors, assistant directors, and heads of concerned services and divisions to investigate “fraudulently procured Philippine citizenship documents, related identity fraud, and the unlawful acquisition or control of property […]...
